svg.text: One toolchain · one recipe language · from local workstation to experiment-wide CVMFS

bits build downloads pre-built artifacts automatically · only builds from source when tarball is absent or hash mismatches
CVMFS — CernVM File System (read-only POSIX · world-wide replicas · auto-mounted on WLCG sites)
